summary: Older man fishing alone fell from his boat in No Name Cove on Lake Pueblo north shore; the empty boat was found adrift Monday afternoon, triggering a 3:25 p.m. 9-1-1 search start. Four CPW rangers searched all night with sonar (severe weather paused efforts until ~7 p.m.); body recovered at dawn Tuesday from ~40 ft of water using a CPW ROV; coroner took possession at 5:15 a.m.
location: No Name Cove, north shore, Lake Pueblo State Park
responding_agency: Colorado Parks and Wildlife rangers (lead); Pueblo County SAR alerted/on standby, never called out
notes: Victim unidentified; date = 2019-06-17 (Monday), pinned via article publication 2019-06-18 (Tuesday) and weekday verification; the search was initiated Monday ~3:25 p.m. and the body recovered dawn Tuesday. Fills a zero-row year for Pueblo County (2019). Parent-opened the North Forty News article this run; CPW-led recovery mirrors the indexed Lake Pueblo drowning rows (e.g. ids 2532/2982).
